focus_areas: Geometric integrity and 3D separation of the clasp mechanism
Sharpness of individual crystal facets in the metal mesh
Separation between beads and metal components
Isolation of background eyeglasses from the necklace boundary
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the junction points between the pink beads and the silver mesh. AI often blurs these connections. Verify if the clasp looks mechanically plausible or if it appears as a nonsensical lump of metal using depth cues. Check if the reflection on the pearls is consistent with a single light source. Ensure the eyeglasses in the corner are treated as background and not merged with the necklace.
image_description: A close-up, top-down view of an ornate statement necklace lying flat on a smooth, light pink surface. The necklace features intricate silver-tone metalwork with mesh-like or filigree patterns encrusted with small clear crystals. These metal sections are connected by clusters of larger beads, including pink faceted stones and white pearls. A silver clasp mechanism is visible near the bottom center. In the top left corner, a portion of eyeglasses is visible.
